projects.title: Sifrah
projects.description: Sifrah is a mobile checklist application developed for the nationwide retail chain Sifrah in Peru. Designed for Android and iOS, it streamlines operations between supervisors and workers, enabling task assignment (individual or group), progress tracking, and the attachment of supporting files or photos. The app includes automatic notifications, daily progress visualization, multimedia help resources, and a personalized user profile. It is part of a complete ecosystem consisting of a backend, a web-based admin panel, and a Flutter-based mobile app. Ideal for businesses needing efficient task management in the field.

Handled local data persistence and offline storage
Implemented the entire mobile application using Flutter and Dart

projects.title: Christogram - Faith-Based Social Network for Schools
projects.description: Christogram is a cross-platform mobile application (Android & iOS) built with Flutter, designed as a faith-centered social network intended for religious institutions and school environments in the United States. It allows users to register, share posts (text and images), comment, like, reply, and participate in interactive challenges to earn points and advance levels. Core features include stories, a user profile with gallery and editing, social interactions (block/report users), and a gamified experience through a level-based point system.

projects.title: Cheros App for Subcontractors
projects.description: A mobile solution that streamlines work-hour tracking and project supervision for subcontractors and workers. The app allows workers to clock in using GPS-based validation, track hours, document job completion with photos, and receive payments. Contractors can create projects, assign workers, monitor progress, generate reports, and issue invoices in a centralized platform.

projects.title: Mitim - On-Demand Home Services Platform
projects.description: Mitim is a dual-platform mobile application designed to connect customers with local service professionals such as electricians, painters, and handymen. Similar to Uber but for services, it streamlines booking, communication, and payments between users and providers, offering real-time tracking, calendar scheduling, and in-app chat powered by Firebase.

projects.title: DailyWeight: Weight Monitor
projects.description: DailyWeight is a cross-platform mobile app designed to help users track their weight daily, stay motivated with their fitness goals, and calculate their Body Mass Index (BMI). It features personalized settings, visual progress charts, daily reminders, and local data storage, making it a complete self-monitoring tool.
